```python
def choose_action(car_position, car_velocity):
    if car_position < -0.25:
        return 2 if car_velocity > 0 else 0
    elif -0.25 <= car_position < 0.4:
        return 2 if car_velocity > 0 else 0
    elif 0.4 <= car_position < 0.48:
        return 1 if car_velocity > 0.03 else 2
    elif 0.48 <= car_position < 0.5:
        return 1 if car_velocity > 0.02 else 2
    elif car_position >= 0.5:
        return 1
    else:
        return 1
```
